fields.title: Preset
fields.help: Each product preset maps to an exact verified local model pack. Max uses Whisper Large v3, Balanced and CPU use Large v3 Turbo, and Fast uses Distil Large v3.5. Complete Offline Setup installs any missing pack before processing.

max.label: Max — Maximum quality
max.help: Uses the verified Whisper Large v3 local pack with beam size 5 and automatic precision. This is the quality reference and normally uses the most time and memory.
max.accessibility_label: Max preset, maximum quality using the verified Whisper Large v3 local pack

balanced.label: Balanced — Everyday
balanced.help: Uses the verified Whisper Large v3 Turbo local pack with beam size 5 and int8-float32 precision for everyday quality and speed.
balanced.accessibility_label: Balanced preset, everyday quality and speed using the verified Whisper Large v3 Turbo local pack

fast.label: Fast — Shortest wait
fast.help: Uses the verified Distil Large v3.5 local pack with beam size 1, int8 precision, and fallback alignment for the shortest normal processing time.
fast.accessibility_label: Fast preset, shortest wait using the verified Distil Large v3.5 local pack

cpu.label: CPU — Lowest memory
cpu.help: Uses the verified Whisper Large v3 Turbo local pack on CPU with beam size 1 and int8 precision for conservative memory use.
cpu.accessibility_label: CPU preset, lowest memory using the verified Whisper Large v3 Turbo local pack

fields.title: Offline mode
fields.help: Require fully local operation. Missing local assets fail fast instead of triggering any network access, and non-local cleanup endpoints are rejected.

fields.title: Model cache
fields.help: Release-managed path to the verified model payload inside the signed installer component. Release builds reject overrides; Debug builds may use an ignored development cache.

fields.title: Model lifecycle
fields.help: Model residency between jobs: auto/persistent keep backends warm for throughput; per-job releases models and allocator caches after each job for lower memory residency.

fields.title: Sample rate
fields.help: Canonical WAV sample rate. The pipeline standardizes on 16000 Hz for recognition.

fields.title: Downmix to mono
fields.help: Mix the source down to a single channel for the canonical recognition audio.

fields.title: Normalize loudness
fields.help: Apply loudness normalization while preparing canonical audio. Helpful for very quiet or uneven sources.

fields.title: Denoise
fields.help: Optional noise reduction before recognition. Mild is conservative; strong can distort speech and should be reserved for very noisy sources.

fields.title: Separate vocals
fields.help: Experimental vocal separation before recognition for music-heavy sources.

fields.title: Preserve channels
fields.help: Keep the original channel layout instead of downmixing when preparing canonical audio.

fields.title: Backend
fields.help: Choose the embedded faster-whisper CTranslate2 runtime or the embedded MLX Whisper runtime. Both resolve only exact verified local model packs; neither downloads models during processing.

fields.title: Model
fields.help: Choose an exact pinned CTranslate2 model. Complete Offline Setup downloads missing verified packs for Large v3, Large v3 Turbo, Distil Large v3, and Distil Large v3.5.

fields.title: Language
fields.help: ISO language code such as en or de. Leave empty to auto-detect from the audio.

fields.title: Task
fields.help: transcribe keeps the source language; translate produces English output.

fields.title: Beam size
fields.help: Beam-search width during decoding. Larger beams improve accuracy at a roughly linear cost in time.

fields.title: Device
fields.help: Compute device for the production faster-whisper backend. auto selects a supported local device; cpu forces CPU execution.

fields.title: Compute type
fields.help: CTranslate2 quantization/precision, e.g. auto, int8, int8_float32, float16. Unsupported combinations are rejected by preflight.

fields.title: CPU threads
fields.help: Explicit CPU thread count for faster-whisper. Automatic uses the library default.

fields.title: Workers
fields.help: faster-whisper worker count for parallel decoding.

fields.title: Batched inference
fields.help: Use the faster-whisper BatchedInferencePipeline. Validate against representative media before relying on it.

fields.title: Batch size
fields.help: Segments decoded per batch when batched inference is enabled.

fields.title: Best of
fields.help: Candidate count when sampling at non-zero temperatures.

fields.title: Beam patience
fields.help: Beam-search patience factor. Automatic uses the library default of 1.0.

fields.title: Temperature schedule
fields.help: Decoding temperatures tried in order when quality thresholds fail, e.g. 0.0, 0.2, 0.4. A single value disables the fallback ladder.

fields.title: Compression ratio threshold
fields.help: Segments whose text compresses beyond this ratio are treated as failed decodes and retried at the next temperature.

fields.title: Log-probability threshold
fields.help: Average log-probability below this value marks a decode as failed for the temperature ladder.

fields.title: No-speech threshold
fields.help: Probability above which a segment is treated as silence and skipped.

fields.title: Condition on previous text
fields.help: Feed prior output back as context. Improves continuity but can propagate hallucinations on long recordings; the engine defaults to off.

fields.title: Initial prompt
fields.help: Free-text prompt biasing the first window, e.g. domain vocabulary or expected names. Kept private; never copied into shareable metadata.

fields.title: Decoder prefix
fields.help: Forced decoder prefix for the first segment. Rarely needed; kept private like the prompt.

fields.title: Glossary file
fields.help: Local text file whose contents seed the initial prompt with project vocabulary.

fields.title: Word timestamps
fields.help: Ask the ASR backend for word-level timestamps. Required for fallback word timing when forced alignment is unavailable.

fields.title: ASR VAD filter
fields.help: Unavailable in the standalone app because its upstream Silero model is intentionally excluded. Leave this off; Auralign's local EnergyVAD remains active.

fields.title: MLX model
fields.help: Choose one of the twelve exact pinned MLX Whisper models. Complete Offline Setup downloads the selected pack, verifies every byte, and keeps normal processing local and offline.

fields.title: MLX model path
fields.help: Blocked audit/development field. Release never accepts an arbitrary MLX model directory.

fields.title: MLX FP16
fields.help: Use half-precision MLX weights where supported to reduce memory use. The selected verified model pack remains unchanged.

fields.title: MLX VAD windowing
fields.help: Use experimental VAD-based windowing with the selected verified MLX model. Disable it if material is clipped or unusually fragmented.

fields.title: MLX VAD window
fields.help: Length of each experimental MLX VAD processing window. Larger windows use more memory; smaller windows may split phrases more often.

fields.title: MLX window padding
fields.help: Audio overlap added around each experimental MLX VAD window to preserve words near a boundary.

fields.title: Enable diarization
fields.help: Segment the recording by speaker with pyannote. Disabling leaves all words unattributed.

fields.title: Backend
fields.help: pyannote runs the local Community-1 pipeline; off disables diarization entirely.

fields.title: Model
fields.help: The product selection is the exact pinned Community-1 payload installed by Auralign. Its upstream gate applies to controlled release-machine acquisition; the cleared packaged copy requires no recipient Hugging Face account.

fields.title: Exact speaker count
fields.help: Pin the number of speakers when it is known. Leave automatic for the model to estimate.

fields.title: Minimum speakers
fields.help: Lower bound for the estimated speaker count. Must not exceed the maximum.

fields.title: Maximum speakers
fields.help: Upper bound for the estimated speaker count.

fields.title: Device
fields.help: Compute device for pyannote. The conservative Apple Silicon topology runs diarization on CPU; MPS remains an explicit evidence-gated canary.

fields.title: Preserve overlap
fields.help: Keep overlapping speech turns in the diarization output instead of flattening them.

fields.title: Exclusive turns for fusion
fields.help: Use non-overlapping exclusive turns when assigning words to speakers, which stabilizes attribution in crosstalk.

fields.title: Agentic diarization
fields.help: Score multiple candidate speaker counts deterministically and pick the best-supported one. Slower; useful when the speaker count is uncertain.

fields.title: Candidate count
fields.help: Explicit number of candidate hypotheses to score. Automatic derives it from the candidate range.

fields.title: Candidate range
fields.help: Inclusive speaker-count range to explore, written like 2:8.

fields.title: Known speakers
fields.help: Anchor candidate scoring around a known participant count.

fields.title: Write decision report
fields.help: Persist the deterministic candidate-scoring evidence as diarization_decision_report.json.

fields.title: Enable alignment
fields.help: Refine word timestamps with forced alignment. Disabling falls back to the ASR backend's own word timing.

fields.title: Backend
fields.help: auto tries WhisperX forced alignment and falls back to ASR word timestamps with a recorded reason; forced makes alignment failures fatal; whisper/fallback skip forced alignment.

fields.title: Language
fields.help: Alignment-model language. Automatic follows the detected ASR language.

fields.title: Model
fields.help: Alignment model key from the manifest (en = wav2vec2-base-960h) or a reviewed local model path. Automatic selects by language.

fields.title: Device
fields.help: Compute device for forced alignment. The conservative Apple Silicon topology aligns on CPU; MPS requires the explicit experiment toggle.

fields.title: Allow experimental MPS
fields.help: Approve an isolated WhisperX MPS experiment. Never used automatically.

fields.title: Run QA heuristics
fields.help: Deterministic transcript quality checks producing qa_report.json: suspect spans, repetition, timing anomalies, and speaker-count review flags.

fields.title: QA-driven re-decode
fields.help: Let QA findings trigger targeted re-decode. If the re-decode mode below is off, the engine promotes it to low-confidence.

fields.title: Re-decode mode
fields.help: Which suspect spans get a second decoding pass. Re-decode is candidate-only: it writes review candidates and never rewrites the canonical transcript.

fields.title: Max spans
fields.help: Upper bound on re-decoded spans per job.

fields.title: Span padding
fields.help: Audio padding added around each suspect span before re-decoding.

fields.title: Re-decode beam size
fields.help: Beam width for the second pass over suspect spans.

fields.title: Re-decode temperature
fields.help: Sampling temperature for the second pass; 0 keeps it deterministic.

fields.title: Write re-decode report
fields.help: Persist redecode_report.json describing selected spans and outcomes, even when the mode is off.

fields.title: Write repaired transcript
fields.help: Retired: the engine rejects this option. Targeted re-decode is candidate-only; review transcript.redecode_candidates.json instead.

fields.title: Speaker matching
fields.help: auto matches diarized clusters against locally enrolled ECAPA profiles; ambiguous matches stay UNKNOWN. off skips embedding extraction.

fields.title: Embedding model
fields.help: Speaker-embedding model from the reviewed manifest (ecapa = SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN).

fields.title: Device
fields.help: Compute device for speaker-embedding extraction.

fields.title: Minimum segment
fields.help: Shortest speech segment used when building cluster embeddings.

fields.title: Maximum speech
fields.help: Cap on speech sampled per cluster when building embeddings.

fields.title: Profile directory
fields.help: Directory of locally enrolled speaker profiles. Automatic uses the engine's default profile store.

fields.title: Match threshold
fields.help: Minimum cosine similarity for a profile match. Higher is stricter; unmatched clusters stay UNKNOWN.

fields.title: Ambiguity margin
fields.help: If the two best profile matches are closer than this margin, the cluster is treated as ambiguous and left UNKNOWN.

fields.title: Identity resolution
fields.help: Deterministic offline post-processor on the completed job. review writes reports and candidates only; apply-safe and apply-approved additionally write derived identity-mapped exports.

fields.title: Known speakers
fields.help: Expected participant count used as review evidence. Apply modes with a count also require a roster.

fields.title: Roster
fields.help: Strict local identity roster JSON naming expected participants.

fields.title: Deliverable format
fields.help: Named-speaker delivery is SRT-first; all additionally writes review sidecars in other formats.

fields.title: Write identity-mapped exports
fields.help: Write derived transcript.identity_mapped.* files. Canonical anonymous transcripts and RTTM are never overwritten.

fields.title: Approved map
fields.help: Current-job, hash-bound approved identity map. Consumed only by apply-approved.

fields.title: External transcript
fields.help: Read-only external transcript used for drift comparison during review.

fields.title: Sibling jobs
fields.help: Related completed job folders whose stable speaker evidence supports this job's review.

fields.title: Sibling root
fields.help: Directory scanned for sibling jobs.

fields.title: Sibling manifest
fields.help: Explicit manifest file listing sibling jobs.

fields.title: Stability config
fields.help: Optional configuration for the diarization-stability comparison.

fields.title: Media review report
fields.help: Reviewed source-media report. Required by, and consumed only with, source media review = reviewed-report.

fields.title: Write media review queue
fields.help: Emit a queue of segments recommended for human media review.

fields.title: Attribution audit CSV
fields.help: Write the attribution audit as CSV alongside the authoritative JSON audit.

fields.title: Source media review
fields.help: How human media review feeds the resolver: queue emits requests; reviewed-report consumes a completed report; none disables it.

fields.title: Turn boundary repair
fields.help: report-only records suspect turn boundaries; label-only may relabel fragments without changing timings.

fields.title: Unattributed label
fields.help: Display label for speech that stays unattributed in derived exports.

fields.title: Minimum apply confidence
fields.help: Apply modes only map identities whose confidence reaches this floor.

fields.title: Profile threshold
fields.help: Similarity floor for enrolled-profile evidence during resolution.

fields.title: Profile ambiguity margin
fields.help: Margin below which competing profile matches are treated as ambiguous.

fields.title: Max fragment duration
fields.help: Turns shorter than this are treated as fragments during boundary repair.

fields.title: Max fragment words
fields.help: Word-count ceiling for fragment classification during boundary repair.

fields.title: Max sibling jobs
fields.help: Upper bound on sibling jobs consulted for stability evidence.

fields.title: Cleanup
fields.help: local-llm sends transcript text to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for cleanup. Canonical transcripts are preserved; cleanup output is a separate artifact.

fields.title: Endpoint
fields.help: OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL. Non-local endpoints are rejected unless remote cleanup is explicitly allowed, and always rejected in offline mode.

fields.title: Model
fields.help: Model name requested from the cleanup endpoint. Automatic lets the endpoint choose its default.

fields.title: Scope
fields.help: punctuation restricts edits to punctuation and casing; readability allows limited rewording within the word-delta budget.

fields.title: Allow remote endpoint
fields.help: Permit a non-local cleanup endpoint. This sends transcript text off this machine; leave off unless that is explicitly acceptable.

fields.title: Write cleanup diff
fields.help: Persist a diff of original vs. cleaned text. Diffs contain transcript excerpts and must remain private.

fields.title: Max word delta
fields.help: Reject cleanup output whose word count drifts from the original by more than this ratio.

fields.title: Split long cues
fields.help: Break long subtitle cues to respect the line width and count limits below.

fields.title: Max line width
fields.help: Character budget per subtitle line. Automatic removes the limit.

fields.title: Max lines per cue
fields.help: Line budget per subtitle cue. Automatic removes the limit.

fields.title: Speaker labels
fields.help: Prefix cues with the speaker label when the speaker changes.

fields.title: Use mapped names
fields.help: Use resolved identity names in derived identity-mapped subtitles where an approved mapping exists.

fields.title: Highlight words
fields.help: Emit per-word highlighting cues (karaoke-style) in supported formats.
